script: Non-workers. Affiliates, such as observers and contractors, need Oracle access but aren't paid. They're converted like other hires, with three settings that keep them out of payroll.
In When and why, pick the non-employment reason for affiliates, not Hire employment.
Set the assignment status to Active no payroll. This keeps them out of payroll, even if a salary or payroll relationship is on the record.
In the work relationship info, exclude them from the new hire report. Paid hires are included. Affiliates, observers, and contractors are excluded.

Before you submit: never use Active no payroll for someone who should be paid; they won't be. Affiliates on campus need a background check, but not an I-9. And there's an open item: HRIS will confirm when to use Add a Nonworker or Add a Contingent Worker instead.
